title: MAP-COMBAT-S01-03 - Creature Mercy / Defensive Escalation Battlefield

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The road tightens around the wreck. The creature plants herself between you and the young, wings half-open, claws in the mud. The cart, the ditch, and the low branches turn the bend into a narrow standoff.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: The road tightens around the wreck. The creature plants herself between you and the young, wings half-open, claws in the mud. The cart, the ditch, and the low branches turn the bend into a narrow standoff.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Use this only if the encounter turns physical. Make the combat board a recoverable failure state where restraint can still win.

sections.title: GM notes
items: The creature defends and flees. She does not fight to the death unless the table hard-commits to killing a fleeing mother.
Winning does not mean killing her. Winning means road cleared and no one made the world worse.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "This is not a monster hunt. This is a defensive standoff. Every turn, you can escalate by threatening her or the young, or de-escalate by creating space, lowering weapons, opening the pups' escape route, or calming her."

sections.title: State controls
items: strixwolfDisposition Creature disposition select calm wary defensive fleeing Move one step toward calm for restraint, one step toward defensive for threats.
